exposure: Neonates with a 5-minute Apgar score >=7 or <7
cohort: 153 patients who underwent alternate category 1 emergency caesarean sections at King Edward VIII Hospital, KwaZulu-Natal, Durban, South Africa, between January 1st and June 30th 2017
finding: Only 5.2% of parturients achieved a decision-to-delivery interval of 30 minutes or less, and there was no significant difference in the median decision-to-delivery interval between neonates with a 5-minute Apgar score >=7 or <7.
